description: Gokhan Kirkil publishes four data files for Man0EUvRE Case Study 6. The Zenodo record has no description, so this entry is bounded by the exact title, project catalogue context and native file inventory. The four CSV names identify IAMC-formatted production, storage level, capacity and emissions outputs. They form an energy-scenario result bundle, while column definitions, units and actual values remain unread. Zenodo provides free open access under CC BY 4.0. The related Man0EUvRE European scenario collection establishes the broader modelling programme, but this deposit does not state its geographical coverage, scenario horizon, underlying model or time step. A limitation is that the missing description prevents a more specific interpretation and the files were not downloaded. The record preserves those unknowns and does not infer a country from the author’s identity.
